verdict.rationale: The docs show runs can pause on waitpoint tokens until an external completion (approval flows), and Trigger.dev describes a checkpoint-resume model, which implies a paused run need not hold a live process. The pack never states how long waits can last or that paused time is free of compute billing; community wish-list posts asking for wait/resume read as feature requests, not concrete failures, so they lower confidence rather than create a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit wait.for/sleep durations of days to months, documentation that waiting runs incur no billable compute or held connections, independent hands-on corroboration of long waits.
